findings.title: Silence notifications is a no-op for Prometheus-only list items
findings.body: Grafana list items now pass only promRule, and the new abilities expose “Silence notifications” for those rules. Clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer, but the drawer is still guarded by rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule). Since rule is undefined in both list views, no drawer opens. Adapt the drawer to the new input or fetch the ruler rule when the action is invoked.

findings.title: Removing the ruler input also removes Pause and Delete actions
findings.body: Every Grafana list item now supplies RuleActionsButtons with only promRule. AlertRuleMenu still requires a Grafana rulerRule to render Pause and any rulerRule to render Delete, even when the new Prometheus abilities authorize those actions. Consequently, users with update/delete permissions lose both actions in the grouped and filtered list views. These actions need Prometheus-compatible handlers or an on-demand ruler fetch rather than disappearing when the initial ruler request is removed.

findings.title: The ability skip token does not disable abilities
findings.body: Passing skipToken calls useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined), which reports Duplicate as supported and allows it whenever the user has Grafana rule-create permission. AlertRuleMenu ORs this result with the ruler abilities, so a user who can create Grafana rules but cannot write external rules now sees Duplicate for an external rule despite its ruler permission check denying the action. Return disabled abilities for skipped inputs so the unused Grafana permission branch cannot authorize actions on other rule sources.

findings.title: Preserve the federated-group restriction for combined rules
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), but now delegates to this implementation, which hardcodes isFederated to false and discards the group metadata. Existing consumers of the combined-rule abilities therefore enable Update and Delete for Mimir rules in groups with source_tenants, although these operations were explicitly unsupported for federated groups before this change. Preserve the group-level immutability check when adapting CombinedRule to the ruler abilities.

findings.title: Keep export available for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: ModifyExport is now supported only when prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) succeeds. Grafana recording rules also support export, and the previous ruler-based check used rulerRuleType.grafana.rule, which included them. Because list items no longer provide the ruler fallback, recording rules lose their Export menu even for users with read permission. Use the Grafana-rule check rather than the alerting-only check for this ability.
